name: Jawline exerciser (Jawzrsize)
lead: Jawline exercisers such as Jawzrsize are handheld devices that users bite or chew against with resistance, marketed to strengthen the jaw muscles and define the jawline.

No studies of these devices were found. Background research shows the masseter can enlarge with habitual heavy use [1], and that repetitive jaw habits have been suggested to contribute to jaw disorders, with limited evidence [2].

paras: The masseter is among the strongest chewing muscles, and habitual clenching, grinding or constant gum chewing can enlarge it, sometimes unevenly [1]. Patients seeking care for masseter enlargement may also have temporomandibular joint problems [1].

Jaw habits beyond normal eating and speaking are listed as possible contributors to temporomandibular disorders, with limited evidence [2]. Management guidelines described there generally favor reversible approaches, and physiotherapy includes gentle jaw exercises [2].

card.summary: A resistance chewing device marketed for jaw definition; no studies on the product exist.
card.note: No studies of the device; repetitive jaw habits are linked to jaw disorders in limited evidence.

quick.overview:
Jawline exercisers are devices you bite against to work the chewing muscles, sold as a way to define the jaw.

No published research on the products was found.
quick.mechanism: Resistance chewing loads the masseter, which can enlarge with habitual heavy use [1].
quick.risks: Repetitive jaw habits are suggested to be associated with jaw disorders, with limited evidence [2].
